classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read by the separate `_prefetch` process via `probe.read_staged` and staged into a queue while the main loop keeps sleeping `compute_s`, so the reading rank's own work is overlapped rather than stalled, though `queue.get()` may briefly wait for the prefetch to catch up.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: in `measure`, the main loop calls `probe.read_staged(path_for(workdir,"masks",i,placing), ITEM_BYTES)` synchronously each iteration and only proceeds to `probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s)` after it returns, so the rank stops and waits on each mask read, and no other rank/process is held up by it since the prefetch worker keeps running independently.
